name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1. Inspired by the engineering marvels and the strategic brilliance on display, he pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Tsinghua University, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he gained invaluable experience as a performance engineer at a local racing team, honing his skills in data analysis and race strategy. 

He transitioned into team management roles, demonstrating a knack for optimizing team performance and fostering a collaborative environment. His approach as Team Principal is characterized by a data-driven decision-making process and an emphasis on empowering his team. Li Wei is known for his ability to identify and nurture talent, creating a culture of continuous improvement within Erebus Motorsport. His flexible leadership style ensures the team adapts effectively to changing circumstances, a crucial asset in the dynamic world of motorsports. He aims to lead Erebus Motorsport to the very top.
